policy.attempts: One attempt per cell, including failures and interrupted attempts; no silent reruns
policy.comparison: Both policies use the frozen V2 controller, movement optimizer, freedoms, constraints and reserves; the added policy targets a task-sufficient additional probe instead of the maximum feasible probe
policy.success: Only actual body-and-foot progress is SUCCESS; SAFE_STOP and RECOVERED_STOP do not count as task completion
policy.truth: Hidden pad strength is evaluator-only; sensing, geometry and error bounds are public
policy.interpretation: Predeclared engineering cases and declared seeds, not a statistical population or independent samples within each trace
policy.holdout: Held-out labels describe condition selection before evaluation; development conditions remain labeled separately
policy.damage: Pad damage is the actual failure latch, including successfully recovered damage; recovery never counts as movement completion
policy.avoidable_damage: A paired maximum-policy pad failure is called avoidable here only when the minimum policy completes the same movement undamaged
policy.prior_failures: The four previous failures remain below the relaxed task load and are not claimed preventable by this experiment
